talk.title: Talk in the browser
talk.intro: Join a voice net from this device. The browser asks to use the microphone; headphones prevent echo.
talk.listenOnly: You can only listen in this net.
talk.denied: You may not enter that net.
talk.pressKey: Press the key or side mouse button you want (Esc cancels)

guide.title: Voice guide
guide.disableAutoOpen: Do not show me guides automatically

intro.title: Talk in voice nets
intro.description: Voice works like a radio: hold push-to-talk and everyone in the same net hears you. Choose above where you talk: here in the browser, or in ATAK on an Android phone.

join.title: Join a net
join.description: Press Join voice and allow the microphone. Then pick a net from the list, which shows the nets you may enter. Headphones prevent echo.

talk.title: Push to talk
talk.description: Hold the big button while you speak, or hold the PTT key: Tab, or any key or side mouse button you choose with Change. The key works only while this browser tab is in front.
talk.alt: The talk panel in the browser while transmitting, with a net picked and the people in it

plugin.title: Load OpenDefence Voice in ATAK
plugin.description: Set up ATAK with the TAK guide first. Then open ATAK's menu and choose Plugins. Install OpenDefence Voice from the list if it is not there yet, and tick it so that it shows Loaded. It connects to voice by itself with your TAK identity: there is nothing to sign in to.
plugin.alt: ATAK's plugin list with OpenDefence Voice loaded

ptt.title: Talk from ATAK
ptt.description: Open Voice in ATAK and pick a net. Hold HOLD TO TX while you speak. Hardware buttons work as push-to-talk too: the Active Key on Samsung XCover and Tab Active, a Pryme Bluetooth PTT button, or volume up once you turn on Volume-up PTT in OD Voice's settings.
ptt.alt: OD Voice in ATAK, joined to a net, with its push-to-talk button

nets.title: Who is in which net
nets.description: Units are your organisation's nets; each is open to everyone or to its members only. Where this deployment has mission nets, Missions come from TAK: you can enter a mission's net shortly after you subscribe to the mission in ATAK Data Sync. Guard, under Missions, is the emergency net, open to everyone. Teams and Roles have a net for each ATAK team colour and role, open to everyone.

units.title: Build the unit nets
units.description: As an admin you build the unit nets on the Nets tab below: add nets and sub-nets, or start from a template or a channel plan under More actions. Open a net to choose who can use it and to add its members.

fixed.title: What you cannot change here
fixed.description: Mission nets and their subscribers come from TAK and are read-only here. A mission gets a net once someone subscribes to it; password-protected missions get none. The Teams and Roles nets are fixed. On the Users tab you can turn voice off for a callsign.
